mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP2D6, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its concentration; additive effects on serotonin, dopamine blockade, and CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, arrhythmias); consider dose reduction of chlorpromazine or alternative antipsychotic; monitor ECG and vital signs.
